svg.title: SOPS + age: how secrets reach runtime

g.text: SOPS + age: how secrets reach runtime
Envelope encryption keeps versioned credentials encrypted.
secrets/lab.sops.yaml contains encrypted values, a MAC and the wrapped key.
Git stores this ciphertext. The raw data key and age private identity stay outside Git.
only an authorized private identity can unwrap the key
Remove temporary plaintext after use. Keep secrets out of logs and arguments.
